title: 逐请求预算闸门与跨进程预留
code: integration/request-gate.js — file-locked reservation authority: booked ledger entries + inflight + unknown reservations are compared inside the shared lock on every decision

src/index.js — installBudgetGate(): agent/request reserves and then refuses by throwing BEFORE llm.stream; agent/pre-step rejects the step early without throwing; session/event settles one reservation per assistant/message (booked) or assistant/attempt (unknown); turn/end closes leftovers as unknown
src/config.js — efficiency.budget.perTaskCalls + enforce ('auto' = enforce exactly when a cap is configured)

crossProcessRace.method: two independent Node processes (test/fixtures/budget-contender.mjs) with a synchronised start, one shared budget file, maxCalls=1
crossProcessRace.observed: exactly one process admitted; the loser refused with OMC/BUDGET-EXHAUSTED; the budget file holds one inflight reservation and a stop-partial checkpoint

retryAccounting.observed: each real send takes its own modelRequestId; the same step reserved twice yields two ids

duplicateListenerIdempotent.observed: a re-entrant reservation of the same id is reported duplicate and consumes no second slot

unknownOutcomeKeepsSlot.observed: a send whose result never arrived stays counted; only releaseUnknown({reason}) frees it, and it is audited in the releases list

restartReconciliation.observed: a fresh process turns a dead owner's inflight reservation into unknown and keeps counting it, instead of refunding on a guess

unknownCostDoesNotBlock.observed: maxUsd blocks only on known cost; an unknown-cost ledger entry is admitted and the verdict states the settled figure is a lower bound

hostProbeRefusal.observed: with maxCalls=1 the second turn never reached the synthetic adapter (dispatch count 1 -> 1), the refusal code was OMC/BUDGET-EXHAUSTED and a stop-partial checkpoint was persisted

boundaries: external CLIs are gated between dispatches only; their caps are never presented as a hard per-call limit (budget.hard=false on those paths)
a retry is counted by the agent/request hook, but the host's own retry policy decides whether a retry happens; OMC does not claim to veto another plugin's retry grant
unknown cost never blocks by itself; a maxUsd verdict is a lower bound, not a bill
